name: שינוי נושא נוסחה – y = √(x² + 4), בידוד x חיובי (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Rearrange the following and make \(x\) the subject of the formula. \[ {{CT:0}} = {{CT:1}}. \] You may assume that \(x>0\) in this question.

\(x\) = [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
To rearrange formulae perform operations to both sides of the formula to obtain an equation with \(x\) as the subject.
\[ {{CT:0}} = {{CT:1}}. \]
First, square both sides of the equation to remove the square root:
\[ {{CT:2}} = {{CT:3}}. \]
Subtract 4 from both sides:
\[ {{CT:4}} = {{CT:5}}. \]
Take square roots of both sides:
\[ {{CT:6}} = {{CT:7}}. \]
Now you have an equation for \(x\).
